def route(command):
    match command:
        case ["greet", name] if isinstance(name, str):
            return f"Hello {name}"
        case ["pause"]:
            return "Paused"
        case _:
            return "Unknown"

print(route(["greet", "Ada"]))
print(route(["pause"]))
print(route(["greet", 7]))
